description: Set up a portal that sends ready-made enquiries by mail (Ofri, Renovero, local.ch, a trade directory). No code needed: the sender and/or subject pattern decide which mails belong to this source, and the target campaign decides where the leads go. At least one of from_pattern / subject_pattern is required — a source with neither would match every mail in the inbox and turn invoices into leads. Cost per enquiry: give cost_amount, or cost_pattern to read it out of the mail (the pattern wins). Left empty it stays UNKNOWN, which is not the same as free.

campaign_id.description: Where the leads land. Omitted: no campaign, the lead is still created.

cost_pattern.description: Regex with ONE group holding the amount, e.g. "Kosten:\\s*CHF\\s*([\\d'.,]+)".

format.description: 'etikettiert' reads 'Field: value' lines (most portals). 'schadstoffanalyse' is the existing, mail-tested reader for Schadstoffanalyse.ch.

from_pattern.description: Substring of the sender address, e.g. '@ofri.ch'.

name.description: How the tenant calls this source, e.g. 'Portal Dachsanierung'.

portal.description: ofri | renovero | localch | schadstoffanalyse | anything else.

subject_pattern.description: Substring of the subject, e.g. 'Neue Anfrage'.

name: create_enquiry_source
